thread:
elena: Uploaded a new compact billing header mock w/ a small balance vs forecast bar above the spend chart. Figma: <https://figma.com/s/compact-header|figma>
elena: Two asks: 1) Scope behavior: if Project selected but has zero spend, should header show zeros or fallback to Org totals? 2) Invoice CTA copy: 'Download invoice' vs 'Download invoice (PDF)'?
raj: Show project numbers when available. If zero, show a subtle fallback row 'Org totals shown (no project activity)' with an info tooltip. Avoid surprise number shifts. :thumbsup:
marta: Agreed. Also add a tiny caption under the bar that says 'Viewing: Project' or 'Viewing: Org' so it's explicit.
tyler: UI: scope pill 'Scope: Project' and when orgFallback=true append '(fallback)' in lighter text. Token chip should be single-line '42.2k tokens' and contrast >=4.5:1.
a11y-bot: Auto-check: token chip fails WCAG AA small text. Recommend darker text or lighter bg; tooltips must be keyboard-accessible and use role="tooltip".
sam: Backend note: I'll add scopeSource (project|org) and orgFallback boolean to billingSummary API so frontend can render deterministically.
elena: Decision: keep button label short 'Download invoice' and add accessible tooltip 'PDF' + update analytics event mapping. Tyler/sam/raj/marta to follow up. Quick touchpoint after mocks updated.
_meta: Design thread: billing header scope fallback, token chip contrast, invoice CTA copy, accessibility checks, and backend fields. Action items assigned.
